content.value: Car A is travelling at a constant speed of 40 m/sec when she passes a parked police officer $^ { \mathrm { B , } }$ who gives chase when the car passes her. The officer accelerates at a constant rate until she reaches the speed of 50 m/sec. Thereafter her speed remains constant. The police officer catches the car 5 km from her starting point. Determine the initial acceleration of the police officer.
